text: "A beverage brand consistently uses a distinctive piece of music in its advertising, alongside images of celebrations, friendship, and enjoyable social experiences. Over time, the music begins to evoke positive feelings among consumers even when they encounter it independently of the brand. In addition, the beverage can and brand logo are embedded in scenes of social gatherings, movies, web series, or lifestyle content, where the product is visible but is not explicitly promoted or discussed. Consumers may not consciously pay attention to the brand placement, yet repeated exposure creates familiarity with the brand." (i) Identify the consumer learning theory being applied in the above scenario. Assess how learning takes place in the given context. (ii) Critically evaluate the role of subliminal perception in influencing brand familiarity and consumer responses in the above scenario.
note: Consumer learning theories and subliminal perception are not in the MM decks yet.

text: "Netflix follows a localization strategy by adapting its content, language, storytelling and offerings to suit the diverse consumer needs, preferences, cultural values and viewing habits of customers across different countries. Coca-Cola follows a glocalization strategy, maintaining a consistent global brand identity while adapting its product offerings, flavours and marketing communication to accommodate local tastes, consumer preferences and cultural differences. In contrast, IKEA (a furniture retailer from Sweden) largely follows a standardization strategy, offering a consistent product range, brand positioning and seamless customer experience across international markets, thereby maintaining a strong global brand identity. Thus, a global brand's choice to adopt standardization/localization/glocalization is influenced by consumer needs and expectations, cultural factors, product attributes, market characteristics, and brand aspirations. All three brands have achieved significant international success despite adopting different global marketing strategies." (i) In the context of the above, evaluate the marketing strategies of Netflix (localization), Coca-Cola (glocalization) and IKEA (standardization) in the global scenario. What market/product factors and features may be responsible for the strategies followed by the respective brands? (ii) Critically evaluate the likely influence on market demand if Netflix follows standardization while Coca-Cola and IKEA adopt localization in their international marketing strategies.
note: Global marketing strategies (standardization, localization, glocalization) are not in the MM decks yet; the cultural environment slide is the closest link.
